systems.role: Procedural enterable-building system. Plans every building, builds shells at start, streams interiors near players.
systems.buildsAtRuntime: Workspace.GwangalliBuildings/<BuildingId> (tag GwB_Building; attrs BuildingId, Kind, DisplayName, Floors, Wear, BoundsCF, BoundsSize) -> Shell (always) + Interior (tag GwB_Interior) -> Floor_<label> -> Furnish (tag GwB_Furnish). Demo district at Config.DISTRICT_ORIGIN CFrame(4283.5,18.9,-200)*yaw(-90) on a 13-stud podium: 8 lots apt(x-112,N) otl(-24,N) villa(33,N) oneroom(95,N) hotel(-135,S, 호텔 씨사이드 + 로열 카지노) plaza(-70,S, 광안 프라자: 부산 돼지국밥 + 광안 공인중개사 1F, PC방/노래방/당구장 2F-4F) bbq(-20,S, 광안 숯불갈비 1F+2F) cafe(18,S). Also 광안 종합병원 (Shared.Hospital.SITE x-704 z1236 yaw90 groundY12.5) and the hideout 삼진전파사 (Shared.Hideout.SITE x-767.8 z348 yaw177). Shop templates (Builder/Shops T.*): cvs (GW25), gukbap, bbq, cafe, pcbang, karaoke, billiards, realtor, hotel_lobby, office; each = finishes() (ShopFloor/ShopCeiling/Lining boxes + ceiling light grid) + counters + Point_<kind> anchors (tag GwB_ShopPoint, attrs ShopId/Point/ShopKind) + Seat parts (tag GwB_Seat) + Shops.staff static figures (no Humanoid). Interiors are parked in ServerStorage.GwangalliBuildingsParked when nobody is near.
systems.dependsOn: Workspace attrs GwB_<ConfigKey> overrides (GwB_Origin, GwB_DEMO_DISTRICT, GwB_BuildAll, GwB_HOSPITAL, GwB_HIDEOUT, GwB_INFILL ...), parts tagged GwB_Site (none in v7 -> demo district is built). Streaming constants: ACTIVATE 42, DEACTIVATE 85, PARK_AFTER 25 s, FURNISH_RADIUS 45, STREET_FURNISH 28, UNFURNISH_AFTER 30 s, BUILD_PARTS_PER_STEP 260. Workspace attribute GwB_Ready = true when started.
systems.interactions: Doors (GwB_Door: swing/double/slide/auto/stall/fire/unit 도어락/room key card/shutter/staff), real elevators (GwB_Elevator, GwB_ElevButton, GwB_ElevDisplay), Interact fixtures (GwB_Fixture: bed, tv, fridge, microwave, shower, toilet, sink, washer, pc, wallpad, massage, vending ...), ShopFlows (편의점 GW25 shelf->basket->POS, 국밥 kiosk->number call, 숯불갈비 grill/flip, 카페 진동벨, PC방 tickets+games, 노래방 rooms + rhythm/voice mode, 당구 physics replay, 호텔 check-in key card, 부동산), Housing/Decor (free furniture placement in owned units), Royal (casino lounges, no gambling), Needs.
systems.constraintsForNewProps: Everything here is created/destroyed/reparented by the server at runtime (interiors parked, storeys unfurnished after 30 s): bind to tags (GwB_Interior, GwB_Furnish, GwB_Shop, GwB_Unit) with GetInstanceAdded/RemovedSignal and AncestryChanged, never cache. Do not hide/move any tagged GwB_* part (Door leaves are animated client-side by DoorAnim from the Frame attribute; Elevator cars move client-side; Screen/Spin/Water/Flicker/MotionLight parts are driven by GwangalliBuildingsClient.Living; Light/Lamp by Ambience LOD). Keep Point_* anchors and GwB_Seat seats reachable; keep door swing volumes (GwB_Blocked) and elevator door fronts clear. Player-owned homes (GwB_Unit with OwnerUserId, GwB_Placed furniture) must not get extra props.

systems.role: Makes every existing walk-in shop of the static map work (order, sit, eat, pay, services) without changing its parts; the main gameplay layer of the 134 street shops + 7 GwShop shops + GS25 venue + Homeplus.
systems.buildsAtRuntime: Workspace.GwangalliBuildingsShopLife/<shopKey> Folder (attrs ShopKey, ShopName, ShopType, Accent, Calling/CallingAt, DisplayPath) with Anchors/ (invisible 1x1x1 Parts, CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch false, each with one ProximityPrompt 'LifePrompt', MaxActivationDistance 6.5, RequiresLineOfSight false, Exclusivity AlwaysShow, attr LifeKind): Cook, Display, Order, Pickup, Table_<n> (above table top +1.2), MenuBoard, Restroom, Bin, Water, Shelf_<i>, HotWater, Microwave, ATM, Tap, Tank, Bell, Mailbox, Tester, Fitting, Chair, NightLight_<i> (tag GwB_NightLight, pocha/grill only, 7.6 studs above floor along the front). Dishes/ folder: Dish_<id>, Setting_<id> (banchan + water cup + 'Sujeo' spoon placed at seat.spot offsets up to +-1.6 x, -0.1..1.05 z), callbell at table corner (max.X-0.35, max.Z-0.35), GrillPlate/OnGrill pieces (tag GwB_GrillPiece), GwB_LifeSeat (invisible Seat at seat top +0.1 when the map seat is not a real Seat). Missing-prop fill: FoodKit 'bin' (1.2x2.2x1.0) and 'water' purifier (1.3x3.5x1.2) placed by Scan.freeSpot along the inside of the back wall. Shops activate when a player is within 75 studs, deactivate beyond 120.
systems.dependsOn: Scan.candidates: any Model with children 'Interior' AND 'ShopFloor' (kind street/gwshop), Models with 'Gondola_1' or 'OpenChiller' (venue), tag GwShop. Footprint: ShopBounds (GwShop) or ShopFloor (+ floorY = ShopFloor top). Names read (must keep): ChairSeat, StoolSeat, Stool, Seat, Cushion, SeatCushion, StoolTop, BarStool (seats); TableTop, LowTableTop, LowTable, CommunalTable, Table, BarTop, WindowBar, Ledge, CounterTop, PassTop, BarCounter, PlasticTable/Top (tables; area>=1.2, top 1.2..5.5 above floor; seats link if 0.15..3.2 below top and <3.0 (bar 2.6) studs away); GrillTable + Coals/CharcoalPot; OrderKiosk, KioskScreen; PosBase, CustomerDisplay, PosScreen, CashDeskTop, PosScreenBack, CardReader; Counter, FrontDesk, WorkDesk, 처방약장; EspressoBody, GroupHead, TapPost, TapHandle, TapBar, CuttingBoard, FryBasket, Fryer, StockPot, Broth, Burner, KitchenPass, PassLedge, PassTray, DripTray, Hood, Grinder, GelatoTub, WaffleIron, SteamerCase; Sign_메  뉴, Sign_MENU, MDBoard, PosterFrame, AFrameBack, XBannerBase; Bin, RecycleBins, 쓰레기통, TrashBin; WaterBottle, WaterPurifier, WaterDispenser; TankWater, HotWater, Microwave/MicrowaveWindow, ATMScreen, DeskBell, Mailboxes, TrayStation, Tester/TesterTable; Door_restroom/DoorLeaf; Gondola/Gondola_n, Fridge/FridgeDoor, OpenChiller, IceCreamChest/ChestGlass, HotBar; PastryCase, CaseGlass, BreadShelf, BreadCabinet, DisplayCase; WallRack, DisplayTable, Rack, WallBay, Hanger, WallShelf, Shelf, Product; AutoDoor / AutoDoor_GS25 / AutoDoor-tagged model (door point); ShopBackWall; GwShopPoint parts (PointKind order/counter/fitting/chair) and GwShopTable models (TableTop/Top + TrayPoint). Seat with attribute Sittable=false is skipped. Model overrides: ShopLife=false, ShopLifeType, ShopLifeMenu, ShopLifeKey, container attr ShopLifeRoot=false. Shop key = '<model name>@<round x>,<round z>' of the floor frame. Bus = ServerStorage.GwangalliShopLife (Event/Request) used by GwangalliShopService and NPC systems.
systems.interactions: 앉기 (table) / 주문하기 / 키오스크 주문 / 계산하기 / 바에서 주문 / 픽업하기 / 메뉴판 보기 / 화장실 이용 / 버리기 / 물 따르기 / 고르기 (shelves) / 온수 붓기 / 데우기 / 잔액 조회 (ATM) / 직접 따라보기 (tap pour minigame) / 수조에서 고르기 / 벨 누르기 / 우편함 확인 / 테스터 써보기 / 입어 보기 / 앉아서 스타일 고르기; seated HUD (먹기, 뒤집기, 짠, 추가 주문, 계산); dine-and-dash auto-pay after 10 s; N빵/treat via Together bridge. Character attrs GwB_Act/GwB_ActBeat/GwB_Utensil/GwB_Hold* drive ShopAnim on every client.
systems.constraintsForNewProps: Scan runs on the SERVER, so local client changes never break the classification, but every runtime anchor/dish position is computed from the ORIGINAL parts: seats sit at the original seat-top CFrame, dishes land at TableTop top Y around seat.spot, prompts float over original counters. A client re-skin must therefore keep: every seat's top within ~0.1 stud and facing the same table; every table top at the same Y and XZ extent (dishes spread +-1.6 x 1.05 studs around each seat spot, bell at the far corner) -> no decorative props on table tops except a narrow centre strip on large tables; counter/pass/POS tops at their Y; the back-wall strip where bin/water purifier may spawn (back wall inner side, 0.12..0.45 of the width either side of centre) free; 7-stud reach around every Anchors part uncluttered. Never add parts named like the names above (a future server rescan or Annex addShop would read them only if server-side; client parts are invisible to Scan, but keep names distinct anyway, e.g. prefix 'GwID_').

systems.role: Shop staff that greet, take orders and SERVE through the ShopLife bus.
systems.buildsAtRuntime: One waiter rig per open table shop in workspace.GwangalliShopStaff (tag GwShopStaff, NPC.luau attribute contract NpcId/NpcKind/NpcLeg/NpcYaw/NpcAct/NpcEmote, GwangalliNPCLooks body). Walks pass -> table with a tray via PathfindingService (WALK 8.5 studs/s), sets staffMode {serve=true}; speech bubbles.
systems.dependsOn: ServerStorage.GwangalliShopLife bus; counter rigs within STAFF_R 32 of the pass/order point; SERVE_TIMEOUT 25 s fallback.
systems.interactions: Greeting on enter, 'N번 손님' pickup calls, 호출벨 response, served dish, goodbye lines.
systems.constraintsForNewProps: The waiter path is computed on server geometry and then interpolated on clients through the NpcLeg polyline: client props in the aisle between the kitchen pass and the tables will be walked through. Keep 2.5+ stud aisles from the pass/counter to every table free of new geometry (rugs/floor decals are fine).

systems.role: A staff NPC behind the counter of every storefront (~400 sites) near players.
systems.buildsAtRuntime: Rigs in workspace.GwangalliShopStaff (tag GwShopStaff, NpcKind 'shop'), only within ON_R 150 studs (removed beyond OFF_R 180), MAX_ACTIVE 36 nearest; BillboardGui bubble on Head; ProximityPrompt '말 걸기'; work acts (teller/wipe/typing/cup/cook ...) every 20-40 s; '어서 오세요' within GREET_R 11.
systems.dependsOn: Site = a Model with a ShopFloor child and a cashier anchor (first of PosBase, CashierPanel, OrderKiosk, FrontDesk, BackBar, POS, BarCounter, 바 카운터, 안내 · 접수 카운터, ShopCounter-tagged, Counter); loose landmark counters (PosBase, POS, BarCounter, FrontDesk, CashierPanel...). Stand spot: from the counter, away from the nearest AutoDoor/Door/ShopWindow (or toward ShopBackWall), at counter half-depth + 1.7 / 2.6 / 3.6 studs (side offsets 0, +-1.4, +-2.4), requiring a free 1.6x2.6x1.6 box at chest height (CanCollide parts with Transparency<0.95 that are not Pos/Counter/Display/Screen/Kiosk/Panel/Register/Till/Card/Band/Desk/Bar block). Skips counters with GwShopClerk/VenueStaff/HospitalStaff/GarageStaff/GwInteractRig within 9 studs, and JOB_SITES 스타벅스 광안리점 / GS25 광안리점.
systems.interactions: 말 걸기 (talk lines per shop kind), greeting, look at player.
systems.constraintsForNewProps: The spot is chosen on the server, so a client prop placed behind the counter will intersect the rig. Keep a 2x3-stud standing zone free from the counter's back edge to ~4 studs behind it (the strip between counter and back wall) in every shop with a cashier anchor; no tall props there (back-bar shelving must hug the back wall).

Instances in slots at ORIGIN (-9600,3000,-9600) + (col*560, 0, row*560), 16 cols, MAX_LIVE 6, kept 150 s after last person: storefront = Rooms.build ShopLife room (sizes table 38x30, kiosk 32x26, counter 28x24, pick 32x26, service 30x24 studs; uses ShopFloor, CounterTop, PosBase, OrderKiosk, TableTop+ChairSeat, GrillTable+Coals, PlasticTable+Top+StoolSeat, BarTop+BarStool, StockPot, Fryer, EspressoBody, TapPost, TankWater, CuttingBoard, Gondola_n, Fridge, HotWater, Microwave, PastryCase, WallRack, FrontDesk, DeskBell, ATMScreen, Door_restroom/DoorLeaf, MDBoard, WaterPurifier, TrashBin; model attrs ShopLifeType/ShopLifeMenu/ShopLifeKey/AnnexRoom/DoorX; a little fake street outside the glass) registered with ShopLife.addShop; building = Builder archetype (apartment/officetel/villa/oneroom/hotel/plaza/venue) at the slot with AnnexGround pad (Plaza/Lawn + invisible 40-stud Bound walls). Doors by part name: Door/GlassDoor/ShopDoor (shop), LobbyDoor/EntranceDoor/DoorLeaf/FrontDoor (main), BackDoor/ServiceDoor (back); glass ShopGlass/ShopWindow; signs Sign_<text> (Sign_2F <name> for upper floors). On the map side, keep storefront Door/ShopDoor/LobbyDoor parts visible and clickable-area-free (prompt sits 2.4 studs outside the door, 3 studs up).

systems.role: Restyles the map's Sign_* boards as a real Korean street; adds sign hardware.
systems.buildsAtRuntime: Workspace.GwangalliSignage: 갈바 frames, neon rims (NightNeon), pavement wash lights (CityLight), LED strips (LEDScreen), 유리창 시트지 (window film on storefront glass), 입간판, 돌출 간판, 층별 세로 간판, 포차 천막 + 전구 (NearLOD models); UpperTenants 2F/3F box signs. All CanQuery=false. Workspace attr GwB_SIGNAGE=false reverts, GwB_Signage set when done.

systems.role: Near-only detail LOD for every map interior.
systems.buildsAtRuntime: Server tags discovery (Workspace already has GwDiscoverTagged=true in v7) and the arrive-hidden pass: each eligible outermost NearLOD Model inside Workspace.Gwangalli (anchored parts only, no tagged/attributed parts, no lights/guis/effects/prompts/scripts/seats/humanoids, not in homes/npcnav/zones/RoomDepth/vehicles) gets Transparency=1 on all parts (shown value in part attr GwT, model attr GwTMix) and attr GwArrive=true; Workspace GwArriveReady=true when done. Clients then show near models within DetailLOD.Radius low 70 / mid 100 / high 150 / saver 48 (+12 hysteresis), 3 Hz, 200/400/800 writes per frame; zone models (LOD='zone', LODRadius, LODCenter, tag ZoneLOD) hidden as a whole beyond their radius.
systems.dependsOn: Shop interiors are Models named Interior/NearDetail/ShopDetail/Detail with attr LOD='near' and tag NearLOD (269 'Interior' models, 2589 NearDetail; ModelStreamingMode Atomic); GwShop Interiors, GS25, karaoke Booth_NN, PC hall, arcade, club rooms, bowling are ZoneLOD.
systems.constraintsForNewProps: Hiding a crude map part must use the property DetailLOD does NOT drive for that root: inside a GwArrive=true root DetailLOD writes Transparency (0/GwT when shown, 1 when hidden) -> hide with LocalTransparencyModifier=1; inside a non-arrive NearLOD/ZoneLOD root it writes LocalTransparencyModifier -> hide with a local Transparency=1 (and disable child SurfaceGuis/Decals yourself). Re-apply on every stream-in (Atomic models come back as new instances) and when the root's GwHideState attribute changes. Don't reparent streamed instances (breaks streaming). Your own detail should follow the same radius (or tag your Models NearLOD locally so DetailLOD manages them).

systems.role: Dims indoor lights and adds indoor eye adaptation.
systems.dependsOn: Every PointLight/SpotLight/SurfaceLight in Workspace (DescendantAdded): Brightness>=0.9 and an upward raycast hits a roof -> Brightness x0.55, Range capped 18, attr GwIndoorDim=<old>. Opt-out: light attr GwIndoorDim set before parenting, or an ancestor Model attr GwKeepBright=true; parents LampHead/SignFrame/Lantern/... skipped. Indoor test: camera ray up 30 hits a part with Transparency<=0.6 and >=3 of 4 horizontal 28-stud rays hit.
systems.constraintsForNewProps: New lights will be dimmed x0.55 unless you set GwIndoorDim (e.g. 0) first; do not make ceilings Transparency>0.6 (the indoor grade would switch off) - overlay ceiling skins instead of hiding ShopCeiling.

systems.script: Client GwangalliWorld/Lights, Signage, NightWindows, MobileQuality; client GwangalliTextures
systems.role: Light budgets, window glass day/night, mobile switches, runtime surface textures.
systems.buildsAtRuntime: Lights: InteriorLight-tagged (AlwaysOn) lights kept on only for the nearest 6/16/24 within 90/140/160 studs (low/mid/high), saver 3/60. Signage/NightWindows own every write to glass named Window/RoomGlass and tag NightWindow. MobileQuality hides RoomDepth models on low (Config.Mobile.HideRoomDepth) and scales SurfaceGui MaxDistance (x0.6 low). GwangalliTextures adds Texture children 'GwangalliTex' to faces of plain anchored block Parts (incl. ShopBackWall, ShopPartition, Partition, Ceiling, Floor ...) within 20/40/50 studs indoors.
systems.dependsOn: Tags InteriorLight, CityLight, NightWindow, NightNeon, NeonTube, NightGlow, RoomDepth, RoomGlass, Window, GwSurfaceGui; GwangalliTextures skips parts under an ancestor with attr LOD='near' or OpenOffset, Humanoid models and EXCLUDE_TAGS (NearLOD, RoomDepth, EditorOnly, Window, AutoDoor, InteriorLight, CityLight ...).
systems.constraintsForNewProps: Never write Material/Color/Transparency of window glass (ShopWindow is safe to leave, Window/RoomGlass are owned). Budget your own lights (they are not counted by Lights). If you hide a map wall with Transparency the GwangalliTex textures on it stay visible -> prefer overlays; put your root under a Folder with attr LOD='near' if you do not want GwangalliTextures to texture your parts.

systems.role: Automatic sliding doors of every storefront (166 AutoDoor models).

rules: R1 Read-only map: never Destroy, rename, reparent, resize or re-CFrame any instance the client did not create (servers scan names + bounding boxes; streaming bookkeeping breaks on client reparent). The only allowed edits to map parts are local visibility (see R3) on purely decorative parts.

R2 Own root: put everything under one client-created Folder, e.g. Workspace.GwInteriorDetailLocal (not under Workspace.Gwangalli, not named GwangalliBuildings*/GwB_*/GwangalliPlay/GwangalliNPCs/GwCvsPlus*, and with no tags the host systems use). Give it attr LOD='near' if GwangalliTextures must not texture your parts.

R3 Hiding crude parts: inside a root with GwArrive=true hide with LocalTransparencyModifier=1 (DetailLOD writes Transparency there); inside other NearLOD/ZoneLOD roots hide with local Transparency=1 (DetailLOD writes LocalTransparencyModifier) and disable their SurfaceGuis/Decals/Textures (incl. GwangalliTex) yourself; re-apply on stream-in and when the root's GwHideState changes; restore exactly on unload.

R4 Never hide or move gameplay parts: seats (ChairSeat, StoolSeat, Stool, Seat, Cushion, SeatCushion, StoolTop, BarStool, any Seat, GwSittable-tagged), table tops (TableTop, LowTableTop, LowTable, CommunalTable, Table, BarTop, WindowBar, Ledge, CounterTop, PassTop, BarCounter, PlasticTable/Top, GrillTable/Coals/CharcoalPot), cashier/kitchen/station parts (OrderKiosk, KioskScreen, PosBase, CustomerDisplay, PosScreen, CashDeskTop, CardReader, Counter, FrontDesk, WorkDesk, EspressoBody, GroupHead, TapPost/TapHandle/TapBar, CuttingBoard, Fryer, StockPot, Burner, KitchenPass, PassLedge, PassTray, DripTray, Hood, Grinder, GelatoTub, WaffleIron, SteamerCase, TankWater, HotWater, Microwave, ATMScreen, DeskBell, Mailboxes, TrayStation, Tester, WaterPurifier/WaterDispenser, Bin/TrashBin/RecycleBins, MDBoard, Sign_메  뉴/Sign_MENU), Door_restroom/DoorLeaf, Gondola_n/Fridge/OpenChiller/IceCreamChest/PastryCase/WallRack/Shelf, ShopFloor, ShopBounds, ShopBackWall, ShopPartition, ShopCeiling, AutoDoor leaves/handles, Door/GlassDoor/ShopDoor/LobbyDoor/EntranceDoor/FrontDoor/BackDoor/ServiceDoor, every tagged anchor (GwShopPoint, GwShopSpot, GwShopTable, GwShopClerk, GwJobStation, GwJobSpawn, GwWorkStation, GwWorkSpot, VenueSpot, VenueBoard, VenueStaff, KaraokeRoom parts KaraokePanel/KaraokeZone, PCStation Seat/Keyboard/MonitorScreen, GymStation/UsePoint, SalonChair, ShopCounter, ElevatorButton/ElevatorStop_n, HospitalBed, HomeEntrance, all GwB_* tags) and NPC rigs/figures. You MAY re-skin them only by overlaying a nicer non-colliding copy at exactly the same pose (seat top +-0.1 stud, same facing; table top same Y and XZ extent) and hiding the original per R3.

R5 New geometry is non-interactive by default: Anchored=true, CanCollide=false, CanTouch=false, CanQuery=false, CastShadow only on large pieces; Massless; no Seats, no Humanoids, no ClickDetectors. Thin overlays (wall/floor/ceiling skins) go 0.02-0.05 stud in front of the map surface so IndoorLight's roof/wall raycasts and ShopLife/ShopStaff server checks keep hitting the real parts.

R6 Keep clear volumes (no new geometry taller than 0.1 stud): AutoDoor slide pocket (leaf width + 2 studs each side, 0.6 deep) and a 4x4-stud vestibule inside every door; a 2x3-stud staff zone from each cashier anchor's back edge to 4 studs behind it (ShopStaff stand spot at half-depth + 1.7..3.6 studs, 1.6x2.6x1.6 box); 2.5-stud aisles from pass/counter to every table (ShopService waiter + ShopLife staffMode); 7 studs around every ShopLife Anchors part and the back-wall strip where the bin / water purifier may be added; 2.5-stud radius around every GwJobStation and 3-stud lanes between consecutive GS25 station points; the Starbucks bar line and customer lanes (Destination frame z 3..37); PC AislePos/ServePos; GymStation fronts; arcade free floor; 2 studs around static NPC figures.

R7 Table tops: ShopLife places banchan, water cup, 수저, dishes at seat.spot offsets up to +-1.6 x / -0.1..+1.05 z and the 호출벨 at the (max.X-0.35, max.Z-0.35) corner; most map tables are only 3.6x2.4 studs, so add nothing on them except flush textures/decals (a napkin/spoon box only where SpoonBox already sits).

R8 Prompts: the host prompts never use line of sight, so your parts cannot block them; your own cosmetic ProximityPrompts must be client-local, named distinctly (not LifePrompt/AnnexPrompt/GwCareerPrompt/GwangalliPCPrompt/GwangalliKaraokePrompt), MaxActivationDistance <= 5, Exclusivity OnePerButton, not within 6.5 studs of a host anchor that already offers an action, and must never duplicate a server action (order, pay, sit, buy).

R9 Lights: set attr GwIndoorDim (e.g. 0) on your lights before parenting or GwangalliIndoorLight multiplies Brightness by 0.55 and caps Range at 18; keep your own nearest-N budget (host budget: Interior 6/16/24 lights within 90/140/160 studs low/mid/high, saver 3); Shadows=false; never toggle InteriorLight/CityLight/GwB_Light lights the host manages.

R10 Glass and signs: never write Material/Color/Transparency/Reflectance of Window, RoomGlass, NightWindow-tagged glass or Sign_* parts/guis (Signage, NightWindows, StreetSigns own them); leave the 1-2 stud strip behind ShopWindow glass low so StreetSigns' 시트지 window film and posters read; respect Config.Mobile.HideRoomDepth (low tier hides RoomDepth fake rooms) if you detail RoomDepth.

R11 Streaming / discovery: StreamingEnabled=true and GwDiscoverTagged=true, so use CollectionService tag signals, not Workspace-wide DescendantAdded. Discover map shops through tag AutoDoor (door.Parent is the shop Model; require a ShopFloor child), NearLOD/ZoneLOD Interior models, GwShop; key a shop like ShopLife: '<model name>@<round(floor X)>,<round(floor Z)>'. Interior/NearDetail/ShopDetail models are ModelStreamingMode Atomic (arrive whole, may return as new instances); the shop Model itself is default (ShopFloor, walls, counters stream separately) - wait for parts with ChildAdded, rebuild on AncestryChanged.

R12 Runtime interiors: build for GwangalliBuildings interiors only after tags GwB_Interior / GwB_Furnish / GwB_Shop appear and drop on removal (server parks interiors after 25 s and unfurnishes storeys after 30 s); Annex rooms/buildings live at y~3000 (ORIGIN (-9600,3000,-9600), slot 560) and only while someone is inside - detect via the local player's GwB_AnnexInst attribute or Model attr AnnexRoom=true; skip player homes (Workspace.GwangalliHomeInstances, GwB_Unit with OwnerUserId, GwB_Placed).

R13 Budget: build only within ~60-80 studs of the camera (DetailLOD radius 70/100/150), time-slice under ~2-3 ms per frame (the host uses 3 ms slices and 200-800 writes per frame), cap parts per shop by tier, and read the tier from ReplicatedStorage.GwangalliQuality.get() (fallback: touch = low).

R14 Skip venues with their own systems: Workspace.Gwangalli.club (CLUB OCEAN), .bowling (lanes, 실내, 상층 venues), .garage showroom floor/turntables, hospital clinic beds; for .karaoke, .pcbang, .convenience (GS25), .arcade and .shops (7 GwShop) only add wall/ceiling/floor finish overlays and decor that respects R4/R6.

R15 Work shifts: when the local player has OnShift / GwWorkShift set (or is GwMgrDuty), do not spawn or animate decor at that store's stations; do not weld or attach anything to characters (host welds uniforms, held props GwB_HoldWeld/GwB_UtensilWeld, restock boxes).
notes: Static vs game: the MAP's own walk-in shops are NOT filled at runtime. The 134 beachfront street shops (Model with Interior + ShopFloor children), the 7 GwShop shops in Workspace.Gwangalli.shops, GS25 광안리점 and 홈플러스 익스프레스 keep exactly the furniture saved in the place; ShopLife adds only invisible prompt anchors, a bin / water purifier where none exists, 호출벨 + banchan/dishes while you eat and pocha lanterns; ShopStaff adds one clerk rig behind the counter (<=36 within 150 studs), GwangalliShopService one waiter in open table shops, and customers exist only at GS25/Starbucks during shifts. So the street-shop emptiness the user sees in game is real, not a static-file artefact. What IS absent from the static place and built at runtime: the whole GwangalliBuildings district at (4283.5,18.9,-200) (8 buildings with shells + streamed interiors: GW25 편의점, 부산 돼지국밥, 광안 숯불갈비 1F/2F, 바다 카페, PC방, 노래방, 당구장, 부동산, 호텔 씨사이드 lobby + 로열 카지노, apartments/officetel/villa/oneroom homes), 광안 종합병원 (-704,~13,1236), 삼진전파사 hideout (-767.8,~7,348), every Annex interior of facade-only buildings (y~3000 slots), Infill lots + 근린상가 (Workspace.GwangalliInfill), life-game homes (Workspace.GwangalliHomeInstances, y 4000+), GS25 shelf products (Workspace.GwCvsPlus Display_slot_*), Starbucks bar equipment (Workspace.GwangalliWork_starbucks), sign hardware/window film (Workspace.GwangalliSignage), 네컷사진관 booths, minigame tables, showroom cars, venue props. Empty placeholders with no filler in v7: Workspace.Gwangalli.living, living_shops, police, hideout, mafia, npcnav (0 children; the Living* feature modules listed in GwangalliGameplay FEATURE_MODULES are not in the place). Quality (static street shops, 134 scanned, see systems_streetshops_static.json): median 43.5 parts in the Interior model (min 0, max 182); 48/134 have no counter-type part; 83/134 have no Light instance (51 lights total); 24 have <=12 interior parts (apartment/hotel lobbies such as 협진태양맨션: 6 MailboxLine strips + one Mailboxes box + fake ElevatorDoor slabs; OCEAN STAY 1, CITY NINE 0, L MOTEL 0, TERRASTAR OCEAN 0). A typical restaurant (남천 해장국, floor 34x18 studs) = 20 chairs of 3 boxes each (ChairSeat/ChairBack/ChairLeg), 5 tables of one 3.6x0.1x2.4 TableTop on a single 1.5-stud TableFoot, 5 SpoonBox, 2 TubeLamp, one Sign_메  뉴 - no kitchen line, no 육수 솥/반찬 냉장고, no 정수기 or 컵소독기, no wall menu with prices, no TV/에어컨/카드단말기, no floor/wall finish beyond single ShopFloor/ShopBackWall/ShopPartition slabs, ceiling a single flat ShopCeiling.
